description: This Java class models the <transaction-factory> XML element in OFBiz's entity configuration. It parses attributes and child elements related to transaction management configuration, such as class name, user transaction JNDI, and transaction manager JNDI.

classes.name: TransactionFactory
classes.description: Models the <transaction-factory> XML configuration element, encapsulating class name, user transaction JNDI, and transaction manager JNDI information.

methods.name: TransactionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on an XML Element, extracting class attribute and child elements.

methods.name: getUserTransactionJndi
methods.description: Returns the UserTransactionJndi object or null if not specified.

methods.name: getTransactionManagerJndi
methods.description: Returns the TransactionManagerJndi object or null if not specified.
